findings.label: Newsletter heading default drift
findings.detail: The newsletter card <h3> now renders settings.newsletterTitle (default 'न्यूजलेटर सदस्यता लिनुहोस्') instead of the old literal 'ताजा अपडेट पाउनुहोस्'. This is design-documented as intentional since the title was already admin-managed. No action required unless the reference phrase must be the shipped default, in which case update the newsletterTitle default string.
